title: Ballerina and Diver Dreamscape
description: A young girl in a pink tutu and roller skates dances joyfully on a swirling candy landscape, while a woman in a full black scuba diving suit with flippers floats upside down in a cosmic ocean, both reaching toward a massive, glowing rainbow mandala portal in the starry sky.
